brief: Implement repo/billing/core.py (classes Billing, BillingError) so the usage->billing path is lossless, tenant-isolated, correctly priced, and auditable. The public API names are fixed. Satisfy ALL requirements at once.

work_packages.title: Implement the full billing module
work_packages.instructions: Implement billing/core.py to satisfy ALL of: R1 ingest(tenant_id,request_id,metric,quantity,timestamp) records an event and usage_for(tenant) lists it; R2 dedup a repeated (tenant_id,request_id) as a no-op; R3 append a 'usage.ingested' audit entry per ingest and expose audit_log as an immutable tuple; R4 usage_for/metered are tenant-isolated; R5 metered(tenant,metric) sums deduped quantity; R6 tiered pricing (first 1000 units @ $0.01, remainder @ $0.008); R7 $5.00 minimum invoice total; R8 round all money to 2 decimals; R9 issue_invoice is idempotent and returns {id,tenant_id,lines:{metric:{qty,amount}},total}; R10 reconcile(tenant) returns drift (0.0 when consistent); R11 append an 'invoice.issued' audit entry on issuance; R12 reject negative quantity with BillingError.
